newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: OZ Holding raises 1996 profit, pays dividend. [CORRECTED 17:16 GMT]
newsitem.headline: OZ Holding raises 1996 profit, pays dividend. [CORRECTED 17:16 GMT]

text.p: OZ Holding, part of the BZ Banking Group, said 1996 group net profit rose to around 33 million Swiss francs, up from 29.6 million the previous year.
OZ, a brokerage that specialises in covered options on Swiss securities, also said it would propose paying a dividend on 1996 results of 30 francs per share.
Last year OZ cut the nominal value of its shares by 40 francs per share to 10 francs.
OZ's 1996 earnings per share (EPS) rose to around 55 francs from 49.50 francs.
As of December 31, OZ's group equity, after (Corrects from including) the partial redemption of 24 million francs of share capital, amounted to 174 million or 291 francs per share.
This compares with an equity of 165 million, or 276 francs per share, on December 31, 1995.
